rules.rationale: A wall thinner than one extrusion line (lineMm) can't be printed: an error. From one line up to the minimum wall (minMm) it prints as a single line, weak and sometimes with gaps: a warning.
rules.source: Rule of thumb: one line is the nozzle's width unless a profile gives its line width; the minimum wall is two lines.

rules.rationale: A face leaning further than this from vertical sags or curls without support.
rules.source: Rule of thumb for PLA with part cooling; 45° is the conservative figure.

rules.rationale: A flat ceiling wider than this sags between its ends even when both are supported, and falls if one is not.
rules.source: Rule of thumb; well-tuned printers bridge further.

rules.rationale: Upright holes this small close up with the first layers' squash and the walls' rounding; drill or ream them, or model them larger.
rules.source: Rule of thumb: about five line widths.

rules.rationale: A part that touches the bed over so little of its footprint can lift or be knocked over; add a brim or turn it.
A part much taller than its base is wide wobbles under the nozzle and can break off.
rules.source: Rule of thumb for a moving-bed printer; a fixed-bed (CoreXY) printer tolerates more.

rules.rationale: A closed cavity prints, but traps whatever is inside it: air on FDM, uncured resin on SLA, powder on SLS.
rules.source: Geometry: a closed shell inside the part.

rules.rationale: Open or non-manifold edges leave the slicer guessing what is inside; repair the mesh before slicing.
rules.source: Geometry: edges not shared by exactly two triangles.

rules.rationale: A part larger than the printer's build volume can't be printed in one piece; split it, scale it or turn it.
rules.source: The printer profile's build volume (0 when no printer profile is chosen: then it isn't checked).
